elements.description: Adds each playable video to the Search index.
elements.name: Search indexer

elements.description: Encodes each upload into streamable segments at several bitrates, with playlists and thumbnails, then announces the video.
elements.name: Transcoder

elements.description: Finds videos by title, description and channel.
elements.name: Search API

elements.description: Gives the player a video's details, playlist and view count, and records each view.
elements.name: Watch API

elements.description: Lets a creator upload a video in resumable parts, with URLs it signs, into Original videos, then queues it for transcoding.
elements.name: Upload service

elements.description: Records each playable video in the Metadata database, once.
elements.name: Completion handler

elements.description: Signs creators and viewers in and issues the tokens the services verify.
elements.name: Identity

elements.description: Sums views per video and adds them to View counts.
elements.name: View counter

elements.description: Each playable video's details, from the Transcoder to the Completion handler and the Search indexer.
elements.name: Completion events

elements.description: Each video as the creator uploaded it, kept to transcode again.
elements.name: Original videos

elements.description: Each video's segments at every resolution, its HLS playlists and its thumbnails.
elements.name: Transcoded videos

elements.description: Each video's view count, added to in batches.
elements.name: View counts

elements.description: Playable videos by title, description and channel.
elements.name: Search index

elements.description: Playable videos: title, description, channel, duration, playlist and thumbnails.
elements.name: Metadata database

elements.description: Uploaded videos waiting to be transcoded, one job each, with title and description.
elements.name: Upload jobs

elements.description: Videos' details by video ID, filled by the Watch API on a miss and kept an hour.
elements.name: Metadata cache

elements.description: Views, from the Watch API to the View counter, keyed by video.
elements.name: View events

elements.description: Local reverse proxy/cache serving video segments, playlists and full-size thumbnails from Transcoded videos. This local substitute is not a globally distributed CDN; thumbnail resizing is disabled.
elements.name: Local video edge

components.description: Accepts only signed-in creators, by Identity's token.
components.name: Creator check

components.description: Adds each video's summed views to its count.
components.name: Count writer

components.description: Adds the playable video's title, description and channel to the search index.
components.name: Index writer

components.description: Announces the playable video with the job's title and description, its duration, playlist and thumbnails.
components.name: Completion publisher

components.description: Cache-aside: looks a video up in the Metadata cache; on a miss reads the primary Metadata database and fills the cache for an hour.
components.name: Details cache

components.description: Consumes completed videos with bounded retries.
components.name: Completion consumer

components.description: Consumes completed videos with bounded retries.
components.name: Completion consumer

components.description: Consumes views in batches with bounded retries.
components.name: View consumer

components.description: Picks frames and stores them as the video's thumbnails, at full size.
components.name: Thumbnailer

components.description: Publishes an upload job once the upload completes, with the video's ID, channel, title and description.
components.name: Job publisher

components.description: Publishes each view the player reports, in batches.
components.name: View publisher

components.description: Queries the index by title, description and channel, a page at a time.
components.name: Video search

components.description: Reads a video's title, description, channel and playlist from the primary Metadata database.
components.name: Details reader

components.description: Reads a video's view count.
components.name: View count reader

components.description: Reads the original and encodes it, in segments of a few seconds, at each resolution and bitrate (ffmpeg); Xu's task DAG runs here.
components.name: Segmenter and encoder

components.description: Records the playable video once, by its ID: title, description, channel, duration, playlist and thumbnails.
components.name: Video writer

components.description: Starts a multipart upload, signs a URL for each part, lists the parts that arrived so the creator can resume, and completes it.
components.name: Multipart uploads

components.description: Stores the segments with an HLS playlist per rendition and one master playlist.
components.name: Packager

components.description: Sums views per video for a few seconds before writing.
components.name: View summer

components.description: Takes one upload job at a time with bounded retries.
components.name: Job consumer

system.description: Creators upload videos that are transcoded for streaming; viewers find them by search, watch them at a bitrate that suits their connection and see how many times each was viewed.
system.name: YouTube
